source_interpretation.text: AgCl, elemental Ga or In, and sulfur are treated with ethylenediamine in a 50 mL autoclave filled to 85%, within 180–230 °C for 10 h. The reported metal charges differ: Ga 0.648 g or In 1.068 g. The source does not assign the exact temperature of either Figure 1/2 sample.

evidence.locator: Main PDF p. 1, Typical procedure and Figure 1

source_interpretation.topic: Solvent coordination is a source interpretation
source_interpretation.text: The authors propose that basic, bidentate ethylenediamine forms a relatively stable Ag+ complex, incorporates dissolved sulfur and permits a liquid–solution diffusion process as Ga melts. Pyridine yields incomplete reaction and lower purity under otherwise constant conditions. Benzene yields mostly unreacted AgCl and Ga and no AgGaS2 by XRD. These comparisons are AgGaS2-specific and are not assigned to AgInS2.

Scherrer estimates are 6 nm for AgGaS2 and 10 nm for AgInS2. TEM diameter ranges are 5–7 and 9–12 nm, respectively. Figure 2 caption links its specimens to Figure 1. Image scale bars are preserved but are not substituted for particle sizes.

evidence.locator: Main PDF p. 1–2, XRD/Scherrer and TEM discussion; Figures 1–2

source_interpretation.topic: Comparisons are not invented discrete trials
source_interpretation.text: For AgGaS2, below 150 °C OR shorter than 5 h gives lower crystallinity; above 250 °C OR longer than 12 h gives larger particles and solvent-carbonization contamination. Exact tested values, paired time/temperature and numerical sizes are not given. The four inequality statements are separate supporting observations, not combined conditions.

evidence.locator: Main PDF p. 2, Temperature and time comparisons

source_interpretation.text: XPS detects no obvious chloride or elemental sulfur impurities at a stated 1 at% resolution limit; this is an analytical limit, not a measured impurity value. The Ag:Ga:S ratio 1:1.08:2.10 belongs only to AgGaS2. Proposed extension to AgMSe2 and CuMS2 (M=Ga, In) is an outlook, not an achieved additional synthesis. Background optical properties and high-temperature solid-state routes belong to cited literature.

evidence.locator: Main PDF p. 1–2, XPS, introduction and conclusion

limitations: Complete two-page main read, both figures/panels/captions and references 1–15. No matching local SI located; cited full sources unreviewed.
The main reports a common 180–230 °C, 10 h preparation window. It does not assign an exact temperature within that window to either pictured/XRD specimen; endpoints are not extra experiments.

Autoclave capacity 50 mL and ethylenediamine fill 85% are reported. No additional neat-solvent volume is calculated; vessel material/liner, headspace gas, pressure, ramp, cooling duration and mixing protocol are unreported.
Dilute-acid identity, acid/ammonia concentrations, all wash volumes/repetitions and filtration hardware are unreported. Aqueous ammonia is not silently reformulated as a particular hydroxide salt.

Pyridine/benzene and threshold comparisons concern AgGaS2 only. Exact trial values, complete schedules, physical batch overlap and separate quantitative sizes are not supplied. No AgInS2 control is inferred.

Cell constants are source-reported XRD-derived lattice parameters, not sample atomic coordinates. The 1 at% XPS resolution limit is not a measured impurity concentration; the Ag:Ga:S ratio is only assigned to AgGaS2.
Independent source comparison passed; molecular/particle/reference-cell presentation remains pending. No measured coordinates or complete laboratory SOP is asserted.
